description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Poolside Paradise,” your dream escape in Seacrest Beach, where every moment feels like a vacation. Perched on the 3rd floor, this condo offers breathtaking views of the 12,000 sqft Lagoon Pool. Walk to the beach in mere 5 minutes, cruise to Rosemary and Alys Beach on included bikes or stroll to nearby boutique dining. With space to unwind and coastal charm all around, it’s the perfect spot to relax, reconnect, and soak up the magic of 30A. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Breathtaking Lagoon Pool Views – Enjoy stunning sights overlooking the expansive 12,000 sq. ft. Lagoon Pool, setting the perfect tone for relaxation and luxury.Modern Elegance Throughout – Newly renovated interiors with high-end finishes create a sleek, sophisticated space that feels like a retreat.Spacious Comfort for Everyone – A 3-suite layout with additional sleeping arrangements, comfortably sleeping 10, ensures everyone has their own space to unwind.Prime Location – Just a 5-minute walk to beach access, delicious dining, and charming boutique shops—experience coastal living at its best.Explore Effortlessly – Includes 4 adult beach cruiser bikes, perfect for leisurely rides through scenic paths and nearby attractions along 30A.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Our family had an amazing time! Comfort, cleanliness, and fantastic amenities. Highly recommend." – Patty O.⭐ “Beautiful, well-maintained condo with everything we needed. Loved the convenient pool access and short walk to the beach!" – Erin B.⭐ "Perfectly located by the pool and restaurants. The bikes were such a fun addition!” – Kimberly S.*** LIVING AREA ***Step into “Poolside Paradise” and enjoy an open-concept living space with natural light pouring in from pool-view windows. Gather in the comfortable lounge, complete with a smart TV and cozy fireplace, or step out onto the private 3rd-floor balcony to take in the tropical Lagoon Pool views.Open-concept living with pool viewsLarge private balcony connected to the living areaBright, airy interiors and modern furnishingsSmart TV and cozy fireplace*** KITCHEN & DINING ***The newly renovated kitchen is fully equipped with stainless steel appliances, ample counter space, and a large center island. The dining table seats 10, while the island offers seating for casual meals or morning coffee.Stainless steel appliances and spacious countersDining table seats 10; island seating for 4Perfect for family meals and group gatherings*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Each bedroom is designed for ultimate comfort, with private en suites and thoughtful details.Primary Suite: 1 King Bed, private en suite with soaking tub, glass-enclosed shower, dual sinks, and a smart TV.King Guest Bedroom: 1 King Bed, private en suite bathroom, and a smart TV.Queen Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds, shared bathroom with Bunk Nook, and a smart TV.Bunk Nook: 1 Twin Bunk Bed, perfect for kids, shared bathroom with the Queen Guest Bedroom.*** LOCATION, COMMUNITY & AMENITIES ***This condo is ideally located in the sought-after community of Seacrest Beach. It offers access to incredible amenities, including a stunning resort-style pool, lush walking paths, and private beach access. You'll also be close to popular shops, restaurants, and family-friendly attractions, making it the perfect place to relax and explore the best of the area.Lagoon Pool – A 12,000 sq. ft. paradise Directly Out the Door, featuring a zero-entry splash zone, waterfalls, and plenty of loungers.Beach Access – Seasonal tram service makes getting to the beach easy, perfect for carrying your gear.Peddler’s Pavilion – A quick 5-minute walk to boutique shops, live music, dining, and seasonal nightlife.Rosemary Beach – Only a 7-minute walk to this scenic coastal destination.Alys Beach – Just a 11-minute walk for picturesque views and charming experiences.Scenic Walking & Nature Trails – Explore beautiful trails just steps away.Bike-Friendly Community – Enjoy the included bikes for easy access to nearby spots.Outdoor Amenities – Relax with outdoor seating, loungers, picnic tables, and a grill station.South Walton’s Tallest Sand Dunes – A unique natural feature of this stunning area.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.This property has 4 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 210098
